summary.text: Zenobia Merced-Bonilla is the Conservative Party nominee for NY Assembly District 87. She ran for New York City Council District 18 on the Conservative line in 2025, finishing third, and is described in a Bronx.com report as a Bronx Conservative Party district leader. Ballotpedia lists no prior elected office for her.

paragraphs.text: Ran for New York City Council District 18 on the Conservative Party line in the November 4, 2025 general election, finishing third behind incumbent Amanda Farias (D/WFP) and Shuvonkar Saha (R) with 582 votes (2.1%).

Described as a district leader in the Bronx Conservative Party in a Bronx.com report published January 31, 2026, which also says the party endorsed her for a different seat, New York State Senate District 34, before she appeared on the ballot for this Assembly seat.

sources.title: Bronx Conservatives Close Ranks: Party Endorses Its 2026 Slate
